about: The rings detect_rings must find exactly, and the pattern a narrative must name for two of them.

rings.name: device_farm
rings.why: Three leads from one device and one network within half an hour, each with a throwaway email.

rings.name: mule_ring
rings.why: Two new leads share the device that signs in to a client flagged for money in and straight out.

rings.name: duplicate_applicant
rings.why: One phone number and one passport under two spellings of one name.

traps.name: office_network
traps.why: Ten genuine leads behind one office network and switchboard number: hubs, joined to no one.

traps.name: cafe_network
traps.why: Two leads who share only a network address: a weak link never makes a ring.
